load_ref_sr3d_data: load_ref sr3d data from a CSV or JSON file and return filtered records with scene metadata
register_ref_datasets: register_ref datasets in Detectron2 DatasetCatalog for SR3D, NR3D, ScanRefer, ScanQA, and SQA3D splits
get_sr3d_meta_categories: get_sr3d_meta build dataset metadata dictionary with thing classes and contiguous ID mappings from a name map
load_ref_batched_captions: load_ref scenes with batched captions grouped by scan_id and optionally shuffled
load_ref_subsample_scenes: load_ref a subsampled set of scenes from a validation or test split for quick evaluation
